source_quote: UV fluence (in mJ/cm2) required to achieve different levels of inactivation (2-log, 4-log, and 6-log) for the target environmental and culture collection strains of E. coli and E. faecium after exposure to LEDs that emit light at different wavelengths.
notes: UV-C LED emitting at 255 nm. Value from Table 2 (culture collection strain row). Fluence required for the stated log reduction was calculated by the authors from the slope of the linear regression of log reduction vs fluence up to 6 mJ/cm2, hence evidence_level=inferred. Wavelength is not a schema field; recorded here. Table 2 also lists an environmental E. coli isolate with very similar values (not extracted).
